# UX Accessibility Checklist: SPEC-013A Run-State Persistence Spine

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-013A UX and accessibility requirements are complete, unambiguous, measurable, and bounded to a compact read-only task-detail run-state section.
**Created**: 2026-05-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by the `/speckit.checklist ux-accessibility` workflow. Gap items found during generation were remediated in `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and this checklist now records the post-remediation requirement-quality state without active gap markers.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the `Run state` / `Stage attempts` surface specified as a compact section in the existing task detail Details tab near Evidence rather than a dashboard, modal control center, or action surface? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK002 Are no-attempt, active-attempt, archived-attempt, no-run-link, linked-run, missing-run, invalid-state, and projection-drift states covered by requirements rather than left to implementation inference? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-027, Contract §No Attempts Response, Contract §Run Link States]
- [x] CHK003 Are read-only boundaries complete enough to exclude claim, retry, release, cancel, launch, scheduler, GitHub, sandbox, harness, and auto-merge controls from the UI? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-023, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are loading, empty, error, archived, missing-run, and projection-drift display requirements explicit that each state has visible text or structural labels and is not communicated by color alone? [Resolved, Accessibility, Spec §FR-028]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the operator-facing section label separated from API terminology so the UI can say `Run state` or `Stage attempts` without exposing raw route/envelope names? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications API/UI Surface, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK006 Are lifecycle values `released` and `cancelled` clearly passive observed states, not operator-facing release/cancel actions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, Data Model §Lifecycle Rules]
- [x] CHK007 Are screen-reader semantics for loading, error, empty, warning, archived, and projection-drift states specified with status/alert/region expectations rather than implied by existing Evidence behavior? [Resolved, Accessibility, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK008 Are optional runtime-run references specified as either allowlisted links with descriptive accessible names or inert read-only text, without turning run state into a launch/open-control affordance? [Resolved, Accessibility, Spec §FR-029]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do spec, plan, data model, and contract consistently keep task-stage-attempt inspection separate from existing task Evidence routes and Evidence section behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Contract §Security And Safety Requirements, Plan §Implementation Boundaries]
- [x] CHK010 Are archived attempts consistently queryable and visibly distinct without implying deletion, recovery, retry, or unarchive behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-021, Data Model §Lifecycle Rules]
- [x] CHK011 Are invalid-state and projection-drift warnings consistently warning-only and free of repair, mutation, retry, release, cancel, claim, or launch behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, Contract §Projection Drift Handling]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Can text fit and density expectations for long stage keys, workflow-template slugs, run ids, warning codes, and lifecycle messages be objectively evaluated in the existing task detail panel? [Resolved, Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-029, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK013 Are screenshot requirements present for no attempts, loaded/mixed attempts, archived attempts, linked and missing run states, and responsive layout? [Acceptance Criteria, Plan §Constitution Check, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK014 Do success criteria require accessibility evidence for loading, empty, error, archived, warning, and read-only/no-control states rather than only screenshot capture? [Resolved, Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-013, Plan §Verification Plan]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Are empty/no-attempt responses explicitly represented as a valid visible-task state rather than an error, hidden section, or unavailable route? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025, Contract §No Attempts Response]
- [x] CHK016 Are linked-run and missing/unavailable-run states covered without requiring a runtime run for pre-run attempt inspection? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Contract §Run Link States]
- [x] CHK017 Are archived and non-archived mixed states covered with archive evidence and lifecycle context preserved in the compact task section? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK018 Are future-control-plane terms and deferred behavior requirements clear enough that disabled buttons, menus, forms, or action-like labels are not introduced as placeholders? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, Plan §Implementation Boundaries]

## Rerun Verification

- [x] CHK019 Does the remediated spec now require non-color-only visible text or structural labels for loading, no-attempt, error, archived, missing-run, invalid-state, and projection-drift states? [Traceability, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK020 Does the remediated spec now require named-region, status, and alert semantics for the compact task-detail run-state section? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK021 Does the remediated spec now require read-only run references to be descriptive links or inert text without command verbs or action controls? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK022 Does the remediated plan now require text-fit and responsive evidence for long identifiers and warning/lifecycle strings in the existing task-detail panel density? [Acceptance Criteria, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK023 Does the remediated plan now require accessibility checks and read-only/no-control assertions, not just screenshots, for the browser journey? [Acceptance Criteria, Plan §Verification Plan]

## Notes

- Initial checklist found five requirements-writing gaps: non-color-only state communication, screen-reader status/error semantics, read-only run-link accessibility, compact text-fit measurability, and accessibility evidence beyond screenshots. These were remediated in `spec.md` and `plan.md`.
